documents.title: 39TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF TINNA RUBBER

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, achieving record quarterly profitability with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores and PAT surpassing INR20 crores. Management highlighted progress on capacity expansions across tyre crushing, MRP, tire pyrolysis oil, and rCB facilities, alongside scaling of the PCMB and PP Build Tech segments. The company maintains its Vision 2029 objectives of reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue, supported by planned capital expenditures of around INR100 crores across FY27 and FY28. Furthermore, management noted increasing demand for rubberized bitumen amid bitumen supply shortages and detailed ongoing international expansion initiatives in Chile, South Africa, Oman, and Saudi Arabia. Tinna Rubber and Infrastructure Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the first quarter of FY27, highlighting record quarterly profitability with standalone and consolidated EBITDA exceeding Rs.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of INR670 crores to INR700 crores for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Yes. So I think we have reiterated the guidelines for this current financial year is somewhere around INR670 crores to INR700-odd crores on the top line side, though we wish to maintain the kind of margin profile, what we have achieved in the Q1, but to stabilize somewhere 18 plus to 20 in between as we feel is achievable.

guidance.claim: Management guides for an EBITDA margin between 18% and 20% for the business.
guidance.quote: So when you blend that with the efficiencies, overall margins of 18% to 20% is what we believe can be delivered in a business like ours, and that is what has played out well in Q1.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY29 while maintaining specific CAGR and return targets.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on delivering our Vision 2029 objectives through capacity expansions, new product development, sustainability-led investments and on expanding our global footprint, we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29, while maintaining 25% plus revenue CAGR, 33% plus profitability CAGR and EBITDA margins over 18% and ROCE exceeding 30%.

guidance.claim: The PCMB division is expected to contribute 10% of FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: With enhanced manufacturing capabilities and strong business momentum, this division is expected to contribute 10% of FY '27 revenue.

guidance.claim: The PP Build Tech business is targeting growth of over 30% and crossing INR100 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting growth of over 30% in this business and cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY '27.

guidance.claim: Pyrolysis TPO and rCB business is expected to contribute approximately 7% to 10% of total revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: Approximately about 7% to 10% of total revenue will come from the pyrolysis TPO RCB business.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The Polymer Composite and Masterbatch business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: Management expects PCMB business contribution to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

guidance.claim: The company projects an overall revenue growth of 20% to 25% in FY27 compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18% under Vision 2029.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

demand_outlook.claim: The infrastructure segment grew by 7% supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.
demand_outlook.quote: The Infrastructure segment delivered 7% revenue growth in Q1 FY27, supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.

demand_outlook.claim: West Asia conflict led to bitumen shortages, creating stronger demand for rubberized bitumen as a cost-effective alternative.
demand_outlook.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment was impacted by sharp increases in raw material prices and import/export disruptions affecting binder and synthetic grass availability.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict, along with import/export disruption affecting the availability of key imported raw material to the turfing industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports volume delivered robust 46% year-on-year growth supported by a healthy order pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports volume delivered robust 46% Y-o-Y growth despite global economic headwinds, supported by a healthy order pipeline.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising raw material costs and ESG focus continued to drive demand in the industrial segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising raw material costs and increasing focus on ESG goals within the tire manufacturing industry continued to drive demand in the industrial segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for rubberized bitumen remains robust, supported by government focus on reducing import dependence.
demand_outlook.quote: While our Bitumen Emulsion business was impacted by supply constraints and subdued market demand, the long-term outlook for rubberized bitumen remains robust, supported by government continued focus on reducing import dependence.

demand_outlook.claim: India is emerging as one of the fastest-growing consumer markets globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The segment continued to offer strong growth potential with India emerging as one of the fastest-growing markets globally.

demand_outlook.claim: High virgin polymer prices are resulting in higher demand for recycled rubber materials.
demand_outlook.quote: It is driven by high prices of the virgin polymers. So, that is one part.

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed INR27 crores of capex in Q1 FY27 as part of a broader INR100 crores investment plan across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28, strengthening our growth and operational capabilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing MRP capacity expansion to 20,000 tons per annum remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The tire pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 FY27 and commercial sales are expected in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY27, with commercial sales by Q4 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY '27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been allocated in Saudi Arabia for a proposed 24,000 tons per annum recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In Saudi Arabia, land has been allocated to the company for a proposed facility of 24,000 tons per annum by recycling facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed Rs. 27 Cr of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned approximately Rs. 100 Cr investment over FY27-FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur, Haryana has been commissioned in Q1 FY27 for the Polymer Composite & Masterbatch business.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional capacity of 12,000 TPA at Gannaur (Sonipat), Haryana, has been commissioned in Q1FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred a capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term growth strategy, we incurred capital expenditure of over INR100 crores during FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The polymer compounding facility capacity in Haryana is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have commenced at the pyrolysis plant, and the rCB plant is under commissioning.
capex_expansion.quote: We are pleased to announce the successful commencement of operations of our pyrolysis plant and the rCB plant, which is under commissioning.

capex_expansion.claim: South Africa Phase 2 full-scale tire recycling crumb rubber production is expected to commence by early Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, Phase 2 focused on full-scale tire recycling has been initiated with crumb rubber production expected to commence by early Q2 of FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved record financial performance with EBITDA margins over 21% and PAT margins over 13% on both standalone and consolidated bases.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: Blended working capital days stand at 50.
margins_costs.quote: We have -- our blended working capital days is 50, and that is fairly consistent actually for our business over the last 2 to 3 years.

margins_costs.claim: Renewable energy solar power contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Renewable energy (Solar Power) has contributed savings of INR 1.19 Cr for Q1FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Tinna Rubber delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: FY26 was another year of strong execution for Tinna Rubber, despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA and PAT margins expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps respectively to 17.2% and 10% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a standalone basis, revenue remained largely stable at INR533 crores, while EBITDA and PAT margin expanded by 286 bps and 161 bps, respectively to 17.2% and 10%, reflecting our strong operational performance and sustained efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: On a console basis, EBITDA margin improved by 206 bps to 17.1%, while revenue and PAT grew marginally by 8% and 9%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: Pyrolysis and rCB plants are expected to operate at EBITDA levels between 15% and 19%.
margins_costs.quote: Our expectation is maybe 15% on the low side and 18% or 19% on the high side.

orders_capacity.claim: Current tire crushing capacity in India stands at 185,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: We currently have a tire crushing capacity of 185,000 tons per annum in India and continue to strengthen our processing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing capacity utilization was at 88% in India and 78% in Oman during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire fishing operations remained resilient in Q1 FY27 with capacity utilization at a healthy 88% in India and 78% in Oman.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: The PCMB division's initial capacity of 6,000 tons per annum operates at 82% utilization, while expansion increased total capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The division's initial 6,000-ton-per-annum capacity operates -- is operating at 82% utilization, while the commissioning of the expanded facility in Haryana has increased our total capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Tinna Rubber expanded its tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The Varale plant reached a capacity utilization level of 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The polymer compounding division operated at 40% capacity utilization during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: The division operating at 40% capacity utilization during the year provides significant headroom for growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: The Oman plant operated at 85% capacity utilization in FY26, generating a revenue of approximately INR30 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Tire crushing volumes increased by 13% in FY26 to 155,000 tons per annum due to an increase in capacity and utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allocated INR5 crores towards research and development in FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31 March 2026 was fully monetized in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31 March 2026 was fully monetized in Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q1 FY26, the company successfully raised approximately INR78 crores through a QIP, attracting participation from leading institutional investors like ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, JM Financial Mutual Fund and Bank of India Mutual Fund.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt declined by 10% to INR121 crores in FY26 from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operating activities grew by 60% to INR57 crores during FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: The company generated healthy cash flow from operating activities, which grew by 60% to INR57 crores during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability in recent quarters in Oman had been impacted by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: While profitability had been impacted in the recent quarters by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis, the implementation of corrective measures, including raw material import into Oman has led to a meaningful recovery in margins and overall profitability during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in subdued volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: India recorded a strong 35% Y-o-Y growth in tire fishing volumes, while operations in Oman were temporarily impacted by the West Asia conflict, resulting in relatively subdued volumes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The West Asia conflict led to temporary bitumen supply shortages and elevated prices, creating a stronger demand for our bitumen as a cost-effective alternative for road infrastructure projects.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla and Saudi Arabia reported a combined loss of around INR53 lakhs owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla and Saudi Arabia reported have combined loss of around INR53 lakhs owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Mbodla Investment Pty Ltd. (South Africa) and Tinna Rubber Arabia Ltd. (Saudi Arabia) reported a combined loss of Rs. 0.53 crore owing to initial start-up costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in Saudi Arabia in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuations, crude oil volatility, and elevated polymer prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: TP Buildtech's performance was impacted by currency fluctuation, crude oil volatility and elevated polymer prices driven by the Middle East crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Oman's performance was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commencement of capital works for the Saudi Arabia tire recycling facility was delayed due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

management_commitments.claim: The ongoing MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27, increasing the company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 tons per annum, which it is our belief is the largest capacity of MRP in the world.

management_commitments.claim: The Varle tire pyrolysis oil facility is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The tyre pyrolysis oil facility at Varle commenced trial in Q1 of FY '27, and it is expected to commence commercial sales in Q2 of FY '27 with operations stabilizing by Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The rCB production is scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY '27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales by Q4 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in the PP Build Tech business in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting growth of over 30% in this business and cross the milestone of INR100 crores in revenue in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects South Africa Phase 1 operations to breakeven by Q2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to breakeven by Q2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Transition of customers for steel abrasives distribution will start from Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Transition of customers will start from Q4FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order scheduled for execution during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Secured a 15,000 MT rubberized bitumen processing order, scheduled for execution during FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management has earmarked INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

management_commitments.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

management_commitments.claim: PCMB business contribution to overall turnover is expected to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the contribution from the PCMB business to increase to 8% to 10% in FY27, supported by strong business momentum.

management_commitments.claim: The Haryana polymer compounding facility is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum capacity by the end of Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27, while trial productions of the rCB plant are scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The TPO production is expected to stabilize by the end of Q1 FY27, while trial productions of the rCB plant is scheduled to begin in Q2 FY27 and we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
